content.title: NSK 6303-ZZ Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 17x47x14mm, Metal Shielded, Steel Cage
content.short_description: NSK 6303-ZZ deep groove ball bearing with metal shields (ZZ), 17mm bore, 47mm OD, 14mm width. Steel cage, dynamic load rating 13.5 kN, static load rating 6.6 kN.
content.long_description:
The NSK 6303-ZZ is a single-row deep groove ball bearing built to the 6303 series dimensional standard, with a 17 mm bore, 47 mm outer diameter, and 14 mm width. The bearing uses a steel cage to retain the ball complement and features ZZ metal shields on both sides, which provide a non-contact barrier against dust and debris intrusion while allowing lubricant retention within the bearing cavity.

Load capacity is rated at 13.5 kN dynamic (C) and 6.6 kN static (C0), figures used to calculate expected service life under rotating loads and to verify suitability against static loading conditions such as at rest or under momentary shock.

Application: general industrial rotating equipment requiring a 6303-series envelope, where metal-shielded protection is acceptable and where mounting orientation, seal exposure to washdown/liquid ingress, or high-contamination environments do not necessitate a rubber-sealed alternative.
